nodes.name: github.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the GitHub OAuth Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628): requests a device/user code pair, then polls the token endpoint until the user approves or a terminal error occurs, using JSON Accept headers to avoid GitHub's URL-encoded response default.

nodes.name: linear.rs
nodes.summary: Implements Linear OAuth Authorization Code grant with PKCE and a fixed loopback redirect (localhost:45445/callback), including the local axum callback listener, code/verifier generation, code exchange, and refresh-token flow.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Unifies the GitHub device-flow and Linear PKCE OAuth flows behind a single OAuthFlowStart wire enum for the frontend's Connect-with UI, and provides ensure_fresh_connection_token to transparently refresh a Linear access token before use.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Wire types for the outbox + sync layer: typed enums (OutboxOp, OutboxStatus, ImportState, EntityType) with as_db_str/from_db_str round-trip helpers so raw SQL string literals never appear outside this module, plus the OutboxEntry and SyncError domain types.

nodes.name: webhook_listener.rs
nodes.summary: Inbound webhook HTTP listener mounted on the shared IDE axum server at POST /sync/webhook/:adapter_id/:slug; resolves the adapter and HMAC secret, verifies the signature, and persists parsed external changes as merge_external outbox rows.

nodes.name: webhook_secrets.rs
nodes.summary: Per-(project_slug, adapter_id) HMAC secret store backing inbound webhook signature verification, providing CSPRNG secret generation, upsert/get/rotate/delete against the webhook_secrets table.

nodes.name: configured_client_id
nodes.summary: Returns the compile-time configured GitHub OAuth client id, if any.

nodes.name: set_test_client_id
nodes.summary: Test-only override for the GitHub OAuth client id.

nodes.name: effective_client_id
nodes.summary: Resolves the client id to use, preferring the test override over the configured default.

nodes.name: http_client
nodes.summary: Builds the reqwest HTTP client used for GitHub OAuth requests with a bounded timeout.

nodes.name: start_device_flow
nodes.summary: Starts the GitHub device authorization flow against the real GitHub endpoints.

nodes.name: start_device_flow_with_endpoints
nodes.summary: Requests a device/user code pair from GitHub's device-code endpoint, requesting JSON to avoid the URL-encoded response default.

nodes.name: poll_for_token
nodes.summary: Polls GitHub's real token endpoint for device-flow completion.

nodes.name: poll_for_token_with_endpoints
nodes.summary: Polls the given token endpoint at the RFC 8628 interval until the user approves, denies, the code expires, or the caller cancels.

nodes.name: RedirectFlowDescriptor
nodes.summary: Internal state for one in-progress Linear PKCE authorization flow: state, code_verifier, callback port, redirect_uri, authorize_url, expiry.

nodes.name: set_test_token_endpoint
nodes.summary: Test-only override for the Linear token endpoint URL.

nodes.name: set_test_client_id
nodes.summary: Test-only override for the Linear OAuth client id.

nodes.name: effective_client_id
nodes.summary: Resolves the Linear OAuth client id to use, preferring the test override.

nodes.name: http_client
nodes.summary: Builds the reqwest HTTP client used for Linear OAuth token requests.

nodes.name: start_auth_flow
nodes.summary: Generates a state and PKCE code_verifier/challenge, reserves the fixed loopback port, and composes the Linear authorize URL for the frontend to open.

nodes.name: await_callback
nodes.summary: Waits for the loopback OAuth callback to deliver the authorization code, using the real system port binding.

nodes.name: await_callback_with_timeout
nodes.summary: Binds the fixed loopback port, serves the callback route until the code/state arrives or the timeout/cancel fires, then tears the listener down.

nodes.name: callback_handler
nodes.summary: Axum handler for the loopback OAuth callback route: validates the returned state against the expected one and forwards the result through the shared channel.

nodes.name: exchange_code
nodes.summary: Exchanges an authorization code for tokens against the real Linear token endpoint.

nodes.name: exchange_code_with_endpoint
nodes.summary: Exchanges the authorization code + PKCE verifier for an access/refresh token pair at the given token endpoint.

nodes.name: refresh
nodes.summary: Refreshes a Linear access token using the real token endpoint.

nodes.name: refresh_with_endpoint
nodes.summary: Exchanges a refresh token for a new access token at the given token endpoint.

nodes.name: OAuthFlowStart
nodes.summary: Wire enum unifying the GitHub device-flow and Linear redirect-flow start responses for the frontend's Connect-with UI.

nodes.name: PollOutcome
nodes.summary: Outcome of polling an in-progress OAuth flow: Token, AccessDenied, Expired, Cancelled, PollFailed.

nodes.name: DeviceFlowDescriptor
nodes.summary: Public device-flow metadata (user code, verification URI, interval, expiry) returned to the frontend.

nodes.name: ensure_fresh_connection_token
nodes.summary: Reads a connection's stored token and, if it's a Linear OAuth token nearing expiry, refreshes it and persists the new record before returning a usable access token.

nodes.name: OutboxEntry
nodes.summary: One row of the outbox_entries table: entity reference, operation, field path, payload JSON, retry bookkeeping, and status.

nodes.name: SyncError
nodes.summary: Typed sync error: Transient, Permanent, RateLimited, AuthFailed, with an is_retryable classification used by the backoff logic.

nodes.name: OutboxOp
nodes.summary: Enum of outbox operation kinds: Create, Update, Delete, MergeExternal.

nodes.name: OutboxStatus
nodes.summary: Enum of outbox row lifecycle states: Pending, InFlight, Succeeded, Failed, Abandoned.

nodes.name: ImportState
nodes.summary: Enum of import_progress row states: Pending, Running, Completed, Cancelled, Failed.

nodes.name: EntityType
nodes.summary: Enum of syncable entity kinds: WorkItem, Project, Label, Milestone, Member.

nodes.name: OutboxProblemRow
nodes.summary: Wire shape for a failed/abandoned outbox row surfaced to the sync-problems UI.

nodes.name: WebhookHandlerError
nodes.summary: Typed error for the webhook handler carrying an HTTP status, a diagnostic note, and the metric outcome to record, with not_found/auth_failed/permanent/internal constructors.

nodes.name: router
nodes.summary: Builds the axum Router exposing the POST /sync/webhook/:adapter_id/:slug route.

nodes.name: handle_webhook_request
nodes.summary: Top-level axum handler: times the request, delegates to handle_inner, records a metric, and maps errors to the appropriate HTTP response.

nodes.name: handle_inner
nodes.summary: Core webhook processing: resolves the adapter and HMAC secret, verifies the signature, parses the payload into external changes, and persists them as merge_external outbox rows.

nodes.name: persist_changes
nodes.summary: Writes a batch of parsed external changes to the outbox as merge_external rows inside one DB connection.

nodes.name: fold_headers
nodes.summary: Flattens axum HeaderMap into the WebhookHeaders shape adapters use for signature verification.

nodes.name: WebhookSecret
nodes.summary: A project+adapter's HMAC secret and last-rotated timestamp.

nodes.name: generate_secret
nodes.summary: Generates a fresh 32-byte CSPRNG secret, hex-encoded.

nodes.name: upsert_secret
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates the webhook secret for a project+adapter.

nodes.name: get_secret
nodes.summary: Reads the stored webhook secret for a project+adapter.

nodes.name: rotate_secret
nodes.summary: Generates and persists a new webhook secret, replacing the old one.

nodes.name: delete_secret
nodes.summary: Deletes the stored webhook secret for a project+adapter.

nodes.name: read_via_pool
nodes.summary: Opens a pooled DB connection and reads the webhook secret for a project+adapter.
